name: core-workflow-principals
description: Workflow's transitions on a table name who makes them (by, the overridePermission past it), a move to the state a row is in may answer as no change (repeat), and a caller may name the state it read (from), D104: cases written by hand in the recorded format, since the engine, which refuses all four, recorded none. Each answer holds what the replayer compares: a record's id, data and behaviors, an operation's result, an event's kind and change, and a refusal whole, in the core's words; what only the engine's store answers (sequence numbers, versions, timestamps, the document a define echoes) is left out. The test behavior test.Gate, which vetoes every Workflow transition of its row, is the reference host's fixture.
